text: Review the design and propose improvements.

I made one proposal. It covers REQ-002 AC3, the done state being visibly distinguishable. No class in the design renders tasks, so I proposed adding a browser-side task list view that shows a ticked checkbox and struck-through text for done tasks. It would also re-render the task at the end of the mark-done sequence (SEQ-003).
Review the design and propose improvements.

I made no proposals. REQ-002 AC3 (the done state is visibly distinguishable) is already covered in the design. UC-003 says a done task shows a ticked checkbox and struck-through text, and a not-done task shows an empty checkbox and plain text. UC-001 describes the same display, and SEQ-003 has the page re-render the Task that PATCH returns. I found no other gaps.
Review the design and propose improvements.

I made 2 proposals. The main one adds a `TaskPresenter` to the Browser page with an `isOverdue(task, todayLocal)` rule, which covers REQ-010 AC3–AC6. The second adds a `renderTask` method that shows the done state and the overdue marker, covering REQ-002 AC3. It also adds re-render messages to SEQ-003.
Review the design and propose improvements.

I made two proposals, one for each uncovered criterion. The main gap is that the Browser page has no class for rendering. The use cases describe the ticked checkbox and struck-through text, but no class or sequence message does it. I proposed adding a `TaskListView` class to the Browser page. Its `renderTask` method would cover REQ-002 AC3, and its `renderList` method would cover REQ-007 AC1. Each would be called from the matching sequence (SEQ-003 and SEQ-001).
